library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(phytools)

# Data set list
datasets <- list(
  "16S" = "Clean_phyloseq_16S.rds",
  "OL4" = "Clean_phyloseq_OL4.rds"
)

# Replace "Candidatus" by "Can."
shorten_candidatus <- function(species_vec) {
  species_vec <- as.character(species_vec)
  species_vec <- sub("^Candidatus", "Can.", species_vec)
  species_vec
}

# Standard labels for Species :
# - NA / vide -> "Unassigned"
# - every variation of "Unknown" -> "Unclassified"
# - every variation of "Unknown species" -> "Unclassified species"
standardize_species_labels <- function(species_vec) {
  species_vec <- as.character(species_vec)
  species_vec[is.na(species_vec) | trimws(species_vec) == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  species_vec <- trimws(species_vec)

  # Unknown species / unknown_species / unknown-species / unknown. species, etc.
  is_unknown_species <- function(x) {
    grepl("^unknown[ _.-]*species$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }

  # Unknown alone
  is_unknown_only <- function(x) {
    grepl("^unknown$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }

  species_vec[is_unknown_species(species_vec)] <- "Unclassified species"
  species_vec[is_unknown_only(species_vec)] <- "Unclassified"

  species_vec
}

# Standard labels for Class :
# - NA / vide -> "Unassigned class"
# - Unknown / Unknown class -> "Unclassified class"
standardize_class_labels <- function(class_vec) {
  class_vec <- as.character(class_vec)
  class_vec[is.na(class_vec) | trimws(class_vec) == ""] <- "Unassigned class"
  class_vec <- trimws(class_vec)

  is_unknown_class <- function(x) {
    grepl("^unknown$|^unknown[ _.-]*class$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }

  class_vec[is_unknown_class(class_vec)] <- "Unclassified class"
  class_vec
}

# Unic identifiers :
# - "Unclassified" -> "Unclassified_1", "Unclassified_2", ...
# - "Unclassified species" -> "Unclassified species_1", ...
# - "X sp." -> "X sp. 1", "X sp. 2", ...
number_species_labels <- function(species_vec) {
  species_vec <- as.character(species_vec)
  species_vec[is.na(species_vec) | trimws(species_vec) == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  species_vec <- trimws(species_vec)

  # Standardization
  species_vec <- standardize_species_labels(species_vec)

  # --- Unclassified species (tolerate spaces/_/./-) ---
  is_unclassified_species <- function(x) {
    grepl("^unclassified[ _.-]*species$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }
  idx_us <- which(!is.na(species_vec) & is_unclassified_species(species_vec))
  if (length(idx_us) > 0) {
    species_vec[idx_us] <- paste0("Unclassified species_", seq_along(idx_us))
  }

  # --- Unclassified alone ---
  is_unclassified_only <- function(x) {
    grepl("^unclassified$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }
  idx_u <- which(!is.na(species_vec) & is_unclassified_only(species_vec))
  if (length(idx_u) > 0) {
    species_vec[idx_u] <- paste0("Unclassified_", seq_along(idx_u))
  }

  # --- "X sp." (tolerate "sp" or "sp.") ---
  is_sp_plain <- function(x) grepl("\\bsp\\.?\\s*$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  idx_sp <- which(!is.na(species_vec) & is_sp_plain(species_vec))

  if (length(idx_sp) > 0) {
    base_name <- function(x) trimws(sub("\\s+sp\\.?\\s*$", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE))
    bases <- base_name(species_vec[idx_sp])

    for (b in unique(bases)) {
      rows_b <- idx_sp[bases == b]
      species_vec[rows_b] <- paste0(b, " sp. ", seq_along(rows_b))
    }
  }

  species_vec
}

# order OTUs/taxa vector by :
# 1) Class
# 2) OTU (alphabetical)
order_within_group_by_class <- function(otu_vec, class_map) {
  otu_vec <- as.character(otu_vec)
  otu_vec <- otu_vec[!is.na(otu_vec)]
  otu_vec <- otu_vec[otu_vec %in% names(class_map)]

  if (length(otu_vec) == 0) return(character(0))

  df <- data.frame(
    OTU = otu_vec,
    Class = unname(class_map[otu_vec]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  df$Class <- standardize_class_labels(df$Class)

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Class, OTU)

  df$OTU
}

for (dataset_name in names(datasets)) {
  cat("\n🔹 Traitement de :", dataset_name, "\n")

  phy <- readRDS(datasets[[dataset_name]])
  phy <- microbiome::transform(phy, "compositional")

  prevalences <- seq(.05, 1, .05)
  detections <- 10^seq(log10(1e-3), log10(.2), length = 20)

  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
  otu <- as(otu_table(phy), "matrix")

  # taxonomic Standardization
  tax$Class <- standardize_class_labels(tax$Class)

  # Does OTUs are well in rows? 
  if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) otu <- t(otu)

  # 1) Put Species in the same order than OTUs
  tax$Species <- shorten_candidatus(tax$Species)
  tax$Species <- standardize_species_labels(tax$Species)

  # 2) unic identifiers by respecting OTUs
  otu_ids <- rownames(otu)
  species_ordered <- tax[otu_ids, "Species"]
  species_ordered <- number_species_labels(species_ordered)

  # 3) change order in tax_table
  tax[otu_ids, "Species"] <- species_ordered

  meta <- as(sample_data(phy), "data.frame")

  otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu)
  otu_df$Species <- tax[rownames(otu), "Species"]

  species_list <- unique(otu_df$Species)
  summed_list <- vector("list", length(species_list))
  names(summed_list) <- species_list

  for (sp in species_list) {
    sub <- otu_df[otu_df$Species == sp, ]
    summed <- colSums(sub[, !(names(sub) %in% "Species")])
    summed_list[[sp]] <- summed
  }

  otu_result <- do.call(rbind, summed_list) %>% as.data.frame()
  otu_result$Species <- rownames(otu_result)
  rownames(otu_result) <- otu_result$Species
  otu_result <- otu_result[, -which(names(otu_result) == "Species")]
  otu_new <- otu_table(as.matrix(otu_result), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

  species_tax_table <- tax %>% dplyr::distinct(Species, .keep_all = TRUE)
  rownames(species_tax_table) <- species_tax_table$Species
  tax_new <- tax_table(as.matrix(species_tax_table[rownames(otu_new), ]))

  # Mapping Species -> Class after aggregation
  species_class_map <- species_tax_table %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, Class) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Species = as.character(Species),
      Class = standardize_class_labels(Class)
    )

  class_vec <- setNames(species_class_map$Class, species_class_map$Species)

  phy <- merge_phyloseq(otu_new, sample_data(phy), tax_new)
  phy <- microbiome::transform(phy, "compositional")

  # ============================================================
  # >>> HostSpecies order = Invasive first, Native after
  # ============================================================
  host_categories_all <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(sample_data(phy))) %>%
    dplyr::select(HostSpecies, Category) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Invasive", "Native"))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Category, HostSpecies)

  ordered_HostSpecies <- host_categories_all %>%
    dplyr::pull(HostSpecies) %>%
    as.character()

  core_otus_all <- c()
  core_otus_by_host <- list()
  hosts_used <- c()

  for (host in ordered_HostSpecies) {
    phy_sub <- subset_samples(phy, HostSpecies == host)
    if (nsamples(phy_sub) > 1) {
      core_phy <- core(phy_sub, detection = 0.001, prevalence = 0.5)
      otus <- taxa_names(core_phy)
      core_otus_by_host[[host]] <- otus
      core_otus_all <- union(core_otus_all, otus)
      hosts_used <- c(hosts_used, host)
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  # >>> Keep only used host
  # + order : Invasive first, then Native
  # + inside Natives, first "D. paulistorum" and then "Willistoni sp."
  # + option OL4 : force "Bipectinata complex sp." and then "D. melanogaster"
  # ============================================================
  ordered_HostSpecies <- ordered_HostSpecies[ordered_HostSpecies %in% hosts_used]

  meta_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(sample_data(phy)))
  host_categories <- meta_df %>%
    dplyr::select(HostSpecies, Category) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  invasive_hosts_ordered <- host_categories %>%
    dplyr::filter(Category == "Invasive", HostSpecies %in% ordered_HostSpecies) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(HostSpecies) %>%
    dplyr::pull(HostSpecies) %>%
    as.character()

  native_hosts_ordered <- host_categories %>%
    dplyr::filter(Category == "Native", HostSpecies %in% ordered_HostSpecies) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(HostSpecies) %>%
    dplyr::pull(HostSpecies) %>%
    as.character()

  native_manual_first <- c("D. paulistorum", "Willistoni sp.")
  native_hosts_ordered <- c(
    native_manual_first[native_manual_first %in% native_hosts_ordered],
    setdiff(native_hosts_ordered, native_manual_first)
  )

  ordered_HostSpecies <- c(invasive_hosts_ordered, native_hosts_ordered)

  if (dataset_name == "OL4") {
    manual_first <- c("Bipectinata complex sp.", "D. melanogaster")
    ordered_HostSpecies <- c(
      manual_first[manual_first %in% ordered_HostSpecies],
      setdiff(ordered_HostSpecies, manual_first)
    )
  }

  invasive_hosts <- host_categories %>%
    dplyr::filter(Category == "Invasive") %>%
    dplyr::pull(HostSpecies)

  native_hosts <- host_categories %>%
    dplyr::filter(Category == "Native") %>%
    dplyr::pull(HostSpecies)

  invasive_hosts <- invasive_hosts[invasive_hosts %in% hosts_used]
  native_hosts   <- native_hosts[native_hosts %in% hosts_used]

  # table HostSpecies -> Category, in the finale order
  host_category_map <- host_categories %>%
    dplyr::distinct(HostSpecies, Category) %>%
    dplyr::filter(HostSpecies %in% ordered_HostSpecies)

  host_category_vec <- setNames(host_category_map$Category, host_category_map$HostSpecies)

  # titles colors by Category
  host_title_colors <- c(
    Invasive = "red",
    Native   = "blue"
  )

  core_matrix <- sapply(hosts_used, function(h) core_otus_all %in% core_otus_by_host[[h]])
  rownames(core_matrix) <- core_otus_all

  hosts_for_common <- setdiff(hosts_used, "Z. indianus")
  otus_communs <- rownames(core_matrix)[
    rowSums(core_matrix[, hosts_for_common, drop = FALSE]) == length(hosts_for_common)
  ]
  otus_invasive_only <- rownames(core_matrix)[
    rowSums(core_matrix[, invasive_hosts, drop = FALSE]) > 0 &
      rowSums(core_matrix[, native_hosts, drop = FALSE]) == 0
  ]
  otus_native_only <- rownames(core_matrix)[
    rowSums(core_matrix[, native_hosts, drop = FALSE]) > 0 &
      rowSums(core_matrix[, invasive_hosts, drop = FALSE]) == 0
  ]
  otus_other <- setdiff(core_otus_all, c(otus_communs, otus_invasive_only, otus_native_only))

  cat(
    "\n✅ OTUs communs:", length(otus_communs),
    "\n✅ OTUs seulement invasifs:", length(otus_invasive_only),
    "\n✅ OTUs seulement natifs:", length(otus_native_only), "\n"
  )

  hilu.subset <- prune_taxa(core_otus_all, phy)
  hilu.subset <- microbiome::transform(hilu.subset, "compositional")

  # ---- OTUs order: group -> Class -> alphabetical ----
  ordered_otus <- c(
    order_within_group_by_class(otus_communs, class_vec),
    order_within_group_by_class(otus_invasive_only, class_vec),
    order_within_group_by_class(otus_native_only, class_vec),
    order_within_group_by_class(otus_other, class_vec)
  )
  ordered_otus <- ordered_otus[ordered_otus %in% core_otus_all]

  label_df <- data.frame(
    OTU = factor(ordered_otus, levels = rev(ordered_otus)),
    color = dplyr::case_when(
      ordered_otus %in% otus_communs       ~ "#556B2F",
      ordered_otus %in% otus_invasive_only ~ "#882255",
      ordered_otus %in% otus_native_only   ~ "#0000CD",
      TRUE                                 ~ "black"
    )
  )

  label_df$OTU_expr <- paste0("italic('", gsub("'", "\\\\'", as.character(label_df$OTU)), "')")

  y_axis_plot <- ggplot(label_df, aes(x = 1, y = OTU, label = OTU_expr)) +
    geom_text(aes(color = I(color)), hjust = 1, size = 4.5, parse = TRUE) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ordered_otus)) +
    expand_limits(x = c(0.7, 1)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(5, 0, 5, 0),
      plot.background = element_rect(color = NA),
      legend.position = "none",
      clip = "off"
    )

  legend_df <- label_df %>%
    dplyr::distinct(color, .keep_all = TRUE)

  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = color, fill = color)) +
    geom_bar() +
    scale_fill_identity(
      breaks = c("#556B2F", "#882255", "#0000CD", "black"),
      labels = c("Common OTUs", "Core Invasive only", "Core Native only", "Others"),
      guide = "legend",
      name = "Core OTUs classification"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position        = "bottom",
      legend.direction       = "horizontal",
      legend.title.position  = "top",
      legend.justification   = "left",
      legend.box.just        = "left",
      legend.title           = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text            = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.key.size        = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      axis.text              = element_blank(),
      axis.title             = element_blank(),
      panel.grid             = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks             = element_blank(),
      plot.margin            = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )

  legend_y_labels <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

  # ---- Légende séparée pour la prévalence ----
  legend_prev_plot <- ggplot(
    data.frame(x = 1:2, y = 1:2, z = c(0, 1)),
    aes(x, y, fill = z)
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "Spectral")),
      limits  = c(0, 1),
      breaks  = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
      labels  = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1"),
      name    = "Prevalence"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position        = "bottom",
      legend.direction       = "horizontal",
      legend.title.position  = "top",
      legend.title           = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text            = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.key.size        = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      axis.text              = element_blank(),
      axis.title             = element_blank(),
      panel.grid             = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks             = element_blank(),
      plot.margin            = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )

  legend_prev <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_prev_plot)

  # ============================================================
  # >>> OVERLAY GREY (Detected in microbiome but not core member)
  # ============================================================
  otu_mat_all <- as(otu_table(hilu.subset), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(hilu.subset)) otu_mat_all <- t(otu_mat_all)

  meta_all <- as(sample_data(hilu.subset), "data.frame")

  present_df <- lapply(hosts_used, function(h) {
    idx_samp <- rownames(meta_all)[meta_all$HostSpecies == h]
    if (length(idx_samp) == 0) return(NULL)

    sub_mat <- otu_mat_all[, idx_samp, drop = FALSE]
    present_in_microbiome <- rowSums(sub_mat > 0) > 0

    data.frame(
      HostSpecies = h,
      OTU = rownames(sub_mat),
      present_in_microbiome = present_in_microbiome,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

  present_df <- present_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      in_core = mapply(
        function(otu, host) otu %in% core_otus_by_host[[host]],
        OTU, HostSpecies
      ),
      present_not_core = present_in_microbiome & !in_core
    )

  core_plots <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(ordered_HostSpecies)) {
    host <- ordered_HostSpecies[i]
    host_category <- unname(host_category_vec[host])
    host_color <- if (!is.na(host_category) && host_category %in% names(host_title_colors)) {
      host_title_colors[[host_category]]
    } else {
      "black"
    }

    core_otus_this_host <- core_otus_by_host[[host]]
    phy_sub <- prune_taxa(core_otus_this_host, subset_samples(hilu.subset, HostSpecies == host))
    n_pools <- nsamples(phy_sub)
    n_otus <- length(core_otus_by_host[[host]])

    if (n_pools > 1 && n_otus > 0) {
      title_text <- paste0(
        "<span style='color:", host_color, ";'><b><i>", host, "</i></b></span><br>(",
        n_pools, " pools - ", n_otus, " OTUs)"
      )

      p_core <- plot_core(
        phy_sub,
        plot.type      = "heatmap",
        prevalences    = prevalences,
        detections     = detections,
        min.prevalence = 0.5,
        colours        = rev(brewer.pal(5, "Spectral"))
      ) +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
          colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "Spectral")),
          limits  = c(0, 1),
          name    = "Prevalence"
        ) +
        labs(title = title_text) +
        scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ordered_otus)) +
        theme(
          plot.title      = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = if (i == length(ordered_HostSpecies)) "right" else "none",
          axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y     = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y    = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x    = element_blank()
        )

      det_levels <- sort(unique(as.character(p_core$data$Detection)))

      overlay_host <- present_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(HostSpecies == host, present_not_core, OTU %in% ordered_otus) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(OTU = factor(OTU, levels = rev(ordered_otus)))

      if (nrow(overlay_host) > 0) {
        overlay_tiles <- tidyr::expand_grid(
          OTU = overlay_host$OTU,
          Detection = det_levels
        )

        p_core <- p_core +
          geom_tile(
            data = overlay_tiles,
            aes(x = Detection, y = OTU),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            fill = "grey85"
          )
      }

      if (length(det_levels) <= 4) {
        show_idx <- seq_along(det_levels)
      } else {
        show_idx <- unique(round(seq(1, length(det_levels), length.out = 4)))
      }

      labels_vec <- rep("", length(det_levels))
      labels_vec[show_idx] <- formatC(
        as.numeric(det_levels[show_idx]),
        format = "f",
        digits = 4,
        drop0trailing = TRUE
      )

      p_core <- p_core +
        scale_x_discrete(
          limits = det_levels,
          labels = labels_vec,
          guide  = guide_axis(angle = 45, check.overlap = FALSE)
        ) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11))

      core_plots[[host]] <- p_core
    }
  }

  core_plots_valid <- core_plots[!sapply(core_plots, is.null)]

  heatmap_combined <- wrap_plots(core_plots_valid, nrow = 1) +
    plot_layout(guides = "keep") &
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  combined_core <- wrap_plots(
    y_axis_plot, heatmap_combined,
    ncol = 2,
    widths = c(0.18, 0.82),
    guides = "keep",
    byrow = FALSE
  ) &
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, -10, 0))

  xlab_grob <- ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_blank() +
    labs(x = "Detection threshold") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin  = margin(-10, 0, 0, 0)
    )

  xlab_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    NULL,
    xlab_grob,
    ncol = 2,
    rel_widths = c(0.25, 0.75)
  )

  bottom_legends <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend_y_labels,
    legend_prev,
    ncol = 2,
    rel_widths = c(0.75, 0.25),
    align = "h"
  )

  combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    combined_core,
    xlab_row,
    bottom_legends,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.05, 0.12)
  )

  ggsave(
    paste0("Heatmap_core_microbiome_by_HostSpecies_", dataset_name, ".pdf"),
    combined, width = 15, height = 9
  )

  ################ 3 heatmaps filtered by OTUs groups ########################################
  otu_groups <- list(
    Common   = otus_communs,
    Invasive = otus_invasive_only,
    Native   = otus_native_only,
    Other    = otus_other
  )

  for (group_name in names(otu_groups)) {
    otus_of_group <- otu_groups[[group_name]]
    hilu_group <- prune_taxa(otus_of_group, hilu.subset)

    if (ntaxa(hilu_group) == 0) {
      cat("⚠ Aucun OTU pour le groupe", group_name, "dans", dataset_name, "\n")
      next
    }

    # Order by classe and then alpha inside group
    ordered_otus_group <- order_within_group_by_class(otus_of_group, class_vec)

    core_plots_group <- list()
    for (i in seq_along(ordered_HostSpecies)) {
      host <- ordered_HostSpecies[i]
      host_category <- unname(host_category_vec[host])
      host_color <- if (!is.na(host_category) && host_category %in% names(host_title_colors)) {
        host_title_colors[[host_category]]
      } else {
        "black"
      }

      core_otus_host <- intersect(core_otus_by_host[[host]], otus_of_group)

      if (length(core_otus_host) == 0) next

      phy_host_group <- prune_taxa(core_otus_host, subset_samples(hilu_group, HostSpecies == host))
      if (nsamples(phy_host_group) < 2 || ntaxa(phy_host_group) == 0) next

      title_text <- paste0(
        "<span style='color:", host_color, ";'><b><i>", host, "</i></b></span><br>(",
        nsamples(phy_host_group), " pools - ",
        ntaxa(phy_host_group), " OTUs)"
      )

      p_group <- plot_core(
        phy_host_group,
        plot.type = "heatmap",
        prevalences = prevalences,
        detections = detections,
        min.prevalence = 0.5,
        colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "Spectral"))
      ) +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
          colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "Spectral")),
          limits = c(0, 1),
          name = "Prevalence"
        ) +
        labs(title = title_text) +
        scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ordered_otus_group)) +
        scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("0.001", "0.01", "0.05", "0.1", "0.2")) +
        theme(
          plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, size = 25),
          legend.position = if (i == length(ordered_HostSpecies)) "right" else "none",
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25)
        )

      core_plots_group[[host]] <- p_group
    }

    if (length(core_plots_group) == 0) next

    core_plots_valid_group <- core_plots_group[!sapply(core_plots_group, is.null)]

    heatmap_group <- wrap_plots(core_plots_valid_group, nrow = 1) +
      plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
      theme(legend.position = "right")

    group_colors <- c(
      Common   = "#556B2F",
      Invasive = "#882255",
      Native   = "#0000CD",
      Other    = "#7A7A7A"
    )

    label_df_group <- data.frame(
      OTU = factor(ordered_otus_group, levels = rev(ordered_otus_group)),
      label = paste0("italic('", gsub("'", "\\\\'", ordered_otus_group), "')"),
      color = group_colors[[group_name]]
    )

    y_axis_plot_group <- ggplot(label_df_group, aes(x = 1, y = OTU, label = label)) +
      geom_text(aes(color = I(color)), hjust = 1, size = 8, parse = TRUE) +
      scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ordered_otus_group)) +
      expand_limits(x = c(0.7, 1)) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        plot.margin = margin(5, 0, 5, 0),
        plot.background = element_rect(color = NA),
        legend.position = "none",
        clip = "off"
      )

    combined_group <- wrap_plots(
      y_axis_plot_group, heatmap_group,
      ncol = 2,
      widths = c(0.25, 1),
      guides = "keep",
      byrow = FALSE
    )

    ggsave(
      paste0("Heatmap_core_", group_name, "_OTUs_", dataset_name, ".pdf"),
      combined_group,
      width = 25, height = 15
    )
  }

  ###################################################################################
  assign(paste0("otus_communs_", dataset_name), otus_communs, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0("otus_invasive_only_", dataset_name), otus_invasive_only, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0("otus_native_only_", dataset_name), otus_native_only, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0("otus_other_", dataset_name), otus_other, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  saveRDS(otus_communs, file = paste0("otus_communs_", dataset_name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(otus_invasive_only, file = paste0("otus_invasive_only_", dataset_name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(otus_native_only, file = paste0("otus_native_only_", dataset_name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(otus_other, file = paste0("otus_other_", dataset_name, ".rds"))

  cat("\n📅 Fini pour :", dataset_name, "\n")
}
